declared_input_scope: Cross-domain hierarchical projection for the declared deterministic small workload and TPC-H-derived SF0.01 Q6.
excluded_facts: database values not selected by the OTel profile
reference_path: ValidatedSnapshot -> core_to_database_projection -> immutable DatabaseDomainProjection -> database_to_otel_projection -> canonical trace B
exact_comparison_fields: complete canonical trace document and bytes
multiplicity_semantics: Occurrence and causal-link multiplicities are preserved independently on both traversal paths.
canonicalization_rules: Both paths may share only the frozen trace canonicalizer and semantic-key formatting utilities.
output_orthogonality_rules: The intermediary and both projections are read-only and cannot alter ordinary workload output.
authority_rules: Path B reads only immutable DatabaseDomainProjection; the two paths share no occurrence, binding, producer-link, or GeneratedOrigin traversal helper.
